    • setIpAddress

      public AuthenticationCreateParams.Channel.Browser.Builder setIpAddress(String ipAddress)

      Collected server-side.

    • setJavaEnabled

    • setJavascriptEnabled

    • setLanguage

      public AuthenticationCreateParams.Channel.Browser.Builder setLanguage(String language)
      Required. An IETF BCP 47 language tag representing the browser language. Typically returned from the navigator.language property, but might also be returned from navigator.languages or navigator.browserLanguage.

      In some cases, this value might be an array. To cast it to a string or null value, you can use the getBrowserLanguage() example function.
